theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ), Integrable f → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : Euclid n → ℝ, Continuous ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) r → ∫⁻ x, ‖convolution ρ f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - f x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
